_note: Tract Number, Lot Number, Construction Type, Occupancy Type have no JNB source - left unmapped for manual entry. 'Circle One: Owner/Tenant/Applicant/Contractor' gets no field (circle-one style, not typed) - EcoSolar always files as Contractor/Applicant, so the Name/Phone/Email/Address block below it is mapped to applicant.*, not owner.*. Photovoltaic kW AC uses solar_kw_ac_only (pure AC, no DC fallback), not solar_kw_ac - Phase A found the fallback silently duplicating the DC value into the AC field when a job has no real AC reading, since both fields would otherwise show side by side (fixed 2026-09-12, see forms_in_progress/example_jobs.py).
